dataset_source: IMD Doppler Weather Radar (DWR) & INSAT-3DR
limitations: No real-time IMD radar grid integration available in prototype testbed.
next_required_evidence: IMD Kullu/Shimla Doppler Weather Radar raw volume scan archives.

model_name: Upper Beas Catchment Hydrological Runoff Model
dataset_source: HPSDMA PDNA 2023 / CWC Thalout High-Water Survey
limitations: Small sample size (N=24: 12 flooded, 12 non-flooded); evaluates high-water footprint rather than continuous hydrograph.
next_required_evidence: Continuous hourly stage-discharge hydrographs from CWC Thalout gauge.

dataset_source: NCMRWF / IMD WRF High-Resolution Grids
limitations: Requires multi-station anemometer telemetry and WRF 3km operational grid feeds.
next_required_evidence: Multi-point valley wind profilers and IMD mesonet telemetry.

model_name: Satellite Multi-Modal U-Net Flood Inundation Model
dataset_source: ISRO NRSC / Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR Water Masks
limitations: Evaluated against 2D radar backscatter thresholded masks; radar subject to mountain shadow; NOT field ground truth.
next_required_evidence: Post-disaster drone photogrammetry and high-density differential GNSS flood mark surveys.

dataset_source: Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB) Pandoh Dam
limitations: Requires official BBMB spillway gate operation logbooks and Pandoh reservoir water balance logs.
next_required_evidence: BBMB spillway gate opening logs and reservoir level records during high-flow episodes.

model_name: Beas Basin Landslide Susceptibility Random Forest
dataset_source: Geological Survey of India (GSI Report 2023) & HPSDMA / ASI
limitations: Small sample size (N=20 scars, N=12 controls); highway corridor (NH-3) accessibility bias; high-altitude ridges under-sampled.
next_required_evidence: Basin-wide multi-catchment landslide inventory including remote ridgelines.

model_name: Beas Basin Rainfall-Induced Landslide Trigger LightGBM
dataset_source: GSI Report M4EGG/C/NR/SU-PHP/2023/46620 / HPSDMA / IMD AWS
limitations: 22 points sampled from ONE SINGLE storm event (July 9-10, 2023); does NOT represent 22 independent multi-year storms.
next_required_evidence: Multi-season storm catalog with in-situ piezometric pore pressure and soil moisture sensors.

dataset_source: Sentinel-1 InSAR / GSI Real-Time GNSS Tiltmeters
limitations: In-situ slope displacement sensors and processed PS-InSAR velocity grids not yet integrated.
next_required_evidence: Continuous sub-centimeter GNSS station data and processed Sentinel-1 PS-InSAR velocity maps.

dataset_source: FLOODY SHIELD Synthetic Fault Injection Testbench
limitations: Software test fixture; evaluates simulated stuck floats and noise; does NOT establish physical telemetry reliability.
next_required_evidence: Multi-month raw telemetry anomaly logs from physical field-deployed sensor stations.

dataset_source: FLOODY SHIELD Synthetic Hydrograph Generator
limitations: Synthetic benchmark; evaluates algorithmic fitting on generated hydrographs; NOT continuous CWC gauge observations.
next_required_evidence: Official authenticated hourly river stage records from CWC Thalout / Bhuntar stations.

dataset_source: ISRO NRSC / Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR Water Masks
limitations: Evaluated against 2D satellite water extent proxy and static watermarks; continuous cross-sectional depth profile unavailable.
next_required_evidence: In-situ bathymetric Doppler velocity profiler (ADCP) transects during high flow.

dataset_source: Froehlich (2008) / Costa (1985) Published Historical Datasets
limitations: Calibrated on global empirical dam breaches; regional in-situ landslide dam breach data for Upper Beas headwaters does not exist.
next_required_evidence: Geotechnical bathymetric and field surveys of local temporary landslide dams in Beas headwaters.

dataset_source: Census of India / District Disaster Management Plan (DDMP) Kullu
limitations: Ward-level census socioeconomic data and local household vulnerability surveys pending integration.
next_required_evidence: Ward-level socioeconomic vulnerability census and post-disaster household compensation records.

dataset_source: FLOODY SHIELD Synthetic Infrastructure Loss Fixture
limitations: Evaluated against synthetic structural damage fixture; NOT certified civil engineering post-disaster audit records.
next_required_evidence: Official PWD road asset loss and bridge structural inspection damage surveys.

dataset_source: OpenStreetMap Graph Export + Synthetic Inundation Overlays
limitations: Evaluates network graph pathfinding on OSM data under simulated road cut scenarios; evacuation drills not conducted in field.
next_required_evidence: District administration emergency evacuation route drills and real-time road closure logs.

dataset_source: FLOODY SHIELD Multi-Hazard Simulation Testbench
limitations: Assesses theoretical risk fusion consistency across simulated scenarios; lacks operational disaster emergency room verification.
next_required_evidence: Multi-hazard emergency response evaluation logs during actual monsoon disaster management operations.

model_name: Early Warning Decision Gating & False Alarm Suppression
dataset_source: FLOODY SHIELD Warning Simulation Fixture
limitations: Benchmarked on simulated multi-source threshold triggers and simulated false alarms; not live operational dispatch.
next_required_evidence: Operational alert issuance and false alarm audit logs during official SDMA trial operations.

dataset_source: Benchtop Laboratory Environmental Chamber Simulation
limitations: Tested against synthetic drift in testbench; long-term multi-season field biofouling and sediment scour unobserved.
next_required_evidence: Long-term 12-month in-situ continuous sensor drift and recalibration logs from mountain stream gauges.

model_name: Flash Flood Wave Celerity & Time-to-Impact Forecaster
dataset_source: Synthetic Torrent Wave Simulation Harness
limitations: Benchmarked on synthetic hydrograph wave travel times; genuine timestamped mountain surge telemetry currently unavailable.
next_required_evidence: Synchronized dual-gauge hydrograph arrival records during high-velocity flash floods.

dataset_source: Synthesized Structural Damage Inspection Fixture
limitations: 510 inspection points are synthesized benchmark fixtures; NOT official municipal post-disaster structural engineer sign-offs.
next_required_evidence: Official certified municipal structural inspection damage records following catastrophic disaster.
